page.notes: Left margin notes: "Mat. 7.6." beside "Ne date fan-stum canibus"; "Mat. 26. 6." beside "reddenda est fidei nostrae ratio"; "Luc. 23. 6." beside "impios vocat porcos". The printed margin reference "Mat. 26. 6." and "Luc. 23. 6." are transcribed as they appear. Doubtful: the word split "fan-" / "stum" (Vulgate "sanctum", printed with long s) is copied as printed, marked here as uncertain. The spacing "Respondetur,Esse" is as printed. The text ends with the hyphenated word "fallaci-" and the catchword "am" is at the lower right. The paragraph is kept as one unit from "Si rursus" to "fallaci-" because the printed lines run on without indents.
